neighbours.label: a lone capital ' A' token that begins a proper name split by the tokenizer (company, product or place names such as Avid, Amdahl, Aegon, Ahold, Afton); names kept whole (Adobe, Apple) and the letter A used on its own (grade A, vitamin A) stay low
fire: The Dutch insurer Aegon reported higher profits this quarter.
Shares of the grocery group Ahold rose after the merger news.
The film was edited on an Avid workstation in a small studio.
Early mainframes from Amdahl competed directly with IBM.
The web server was developed by a small firm called Aprelium.
Walkers often climb from the village up onto Afton Down.
The consultants from A.T. Kearney presented their findings.
Analysts expect Aegon to sell part of its American business.
quiet: The Dutch insurer Allianz reported higher profits this quarter.
Shares of the grocery group Aldi rose after the merger news.
The film was edited on an Apple workstation in a small studio.
Early mainframes from IBM dominated the market for years.
The web server was developed by a small firm called Apache.
Students who score an A in every subject receive a prize.
The consultants from McKinsey presented their findings.
Carrots are a good source of vitamin A and fibre.

short: ' A' starting a split proper name
notes: Card: ' A' x14 (A.T. Kearney, AFS, Amdahl, Avid, Afton, Aprelium), ' O' x4. Tokenizer: ' Aegon' -> ' A','eg','on', ' Ahold' -> ' A','hold', ' Aprelium' -> ' A','pre'..; ' Adobe', ' Apple', ' Audi', ' Airbus' single tokens. Probe: 'from Avid' 0.654, 'AFS Trinity' 0.632, 'Afton Down' 0.357, 'Amdahl' 0.332; 'from Adobe' 0.018, 'Akamai' (' Ak') 0.036, 'an A on his exam' 0.083, 'Vitamin A' 0.015.
